## 9. Use in parallel experiments

For a fresh session, extract to a separate output and source it. The
validation chunks are deliberately excluded from `purl()` below, so
sourcing defines functions only. Knitting still runs both validations.
Do not write the extracted script to `brasilfunc.R`.

```r
knitr::purl("kappa0func.Rmd", output = "kappa0func.R", quiet = TRUE)
source("kappa0func.R")

data <- kappa0_tadpole_data(h = 1/32)
grid <- kappa0_time_grid(T_final = 0.5, target_step = 0.01)
op <- my.fractional.operators.kappa0(
    G = data$G, beta = 1.2/2, C = data$C,
    scale.factor = data$mesh$gamma_star, m = 8,
    time_step = grid$time_step, diffusion = 1)

# Same load-vector convention as my.solver.frac():
rhs <- as.numeric(data$C %*% data$initial) + grid$time_step * data$spatial_load
U1 <- my.solver.kappa0(op, rhs)

result <- kappa0_evolution(op, data$initial, grid$N,
                          function(left, right) data$spatial_load)
result$max_mass_error
```

For new data, construct `initial_load`, then use
`kappa0_project(op, initial_load)` to obtain the initial coefficients.
For a MetricGraph mesh, call `graph$compute_fem()`, use `graph$mesh$C`
and `graph$mesh$G`, assemble loads in its own node order, and supply a
certified gap bound based on that graph's length and diameter. The sparse
solver does not depend on the tadpole assembler or spectral routines.
Do not pass a positive-shift `L` as `G`, or reuse an operator object after
changing the step size. Existing positive-shift C++ evolution kernels
call the original solver and do not automatically acquire the new mean
splitting; use the driver defined here for zero-shift runs.

The independent spectral reference uses dense storage and is intentionally
limited to moderate meshes; the sparse rational scheme uses no discrete
eigendecomposition. The helper callback is responsible for accurate
space and time integration of other forcing data. In further spatial or
temporal convergence studies, reduce the rational contribution separately
and keep the same mean recurrence in all references. The validations
above create no saved data or figures and change no existing experiment.

## 10. Reusable zero-shift convergence-experiment helpers

The four `true_diff_*.Rmd` notebooks use this section in addition to the
operator above. They retain the original studies' consistent-mass FEM,
analytical data loads, interval-averaged sine forcing, right-constant
reconstruction, and sampled space-time norm. Their filenames and result
paths are separate from the positive-shift studies. No original notebook
or extracted `brasilfunc.R` is sourced or regenerated.

The copied reference-norm and forcing-convolution algorithms below come
from `brasilfunc.Rmd`, with a `kappa0_` prefix. The compiled stepping loop
adds the same full-load mean split as `my.solver.kappa0()` at every step:
compute `rhs.sum()/volume`, subtract that mean times `C*one`, perform the
cached shifted solves, remove their residual coefficient mean, and restore
the saved next mean. It advances **every** backward Euler step, even when
the reference grid samples fewer times. It records the maximum mass
balance discrepancy along the trajectory. The R and compiled paths are compared by a separate internal script in
`/home/rierasl/Desktop/DOCS/NAP/true_diff_internal`; the convergence
notebooks do not run those tests. C++ uses Eigen sparse Cholesky factorizations of the same matrices;
the R path uses Matrix's factorizations.

The smooth convergence data retain the original 16 normalized initial
modes and the forced mode 7 from `main.tex`. The default initial and
forcing means are both zero; no constant components are added. The same
17 active modes define the analytical reference, with unshifted rates.
The optional nonzero-mean arguments support separate internal tests, not
a different default convergence problem. The revised paper's nonzero-mean
single-mode benchmark is kept distinct from these convergence studies.

The rough experiment retains the original quarter-loop symmetry reduction.
It represents four reflected copies of `[0,1/2]` with homogeneous endpoint
values, so its matrices and mass norm carry a factor four. Constants are
absent from this invariant antisymmetric subspace. Consequently its
restricted zero-shift operator is strictly positive, and `split_mean=FALSE`
is required: subtracting an arithmetic or FEM mean on the quarter interval
would destroy the symmetry. The full-graph extension has exactly zero
mass. `kappa0_rough_operator()` uses the same source coefficients, positive
gap scale, shifted matrices, and partial-fraction solver, restricted to
that subspace; it does not call the connected full-space constructor,
whose check `G %*% one = 0` does not hold after Dirichlet restriction.
A separate full-tadpole comparison in the internal test directory verifies this reduction.

```{r kappa0-experiment-reference-functions}
kappa0_prepare_reference_error <- function(Psi, reference_C, reference_basis) {
    E <- as.matrix(reference_basis)
    stopifnot(nrow(Psi) == nrow(reference_C), nrow(reference_C) == ncol(reference_C), nrow(E) == nrow(Psi), ncol(E) >=
        1L, all(is.finite(E)))
    metric <- Matrix::forceSymmetric(as(Matrix::Matrix(Matrix::crossprod(Psi, reference_C %*% Psi), sparse = TRUE),
        "CsparseMatrix"))
    cross <- Matrix::crossprod(Psi, reference_C %*% E)
    factor <- Matrix::Cholesky(metric, LDL = FALSE)
    projection <- as.matrix(Matrix::solve(factor, cross, system = "A"))
    residual <- E - as.matrix(Psi %*% projection)
    list(metric = metric, projection = projection, residual_gram = as.matrix(Matrix::crossprod(residual, reference_C %*%
        residual)), exact_gram = as.matrix(Matrix::crossprod(E, reference_C %*% E)))
}

kappa0_reference_coefficient_moments <- function(coefficients, weights) {
    coefficients <- as.matrix(coefficients)
    stopifnot(nrow(coefficients) >= 1L, ncol(coefficients) == length(weights), length(weights) >= 1L, all(is.finite(coefficients)),
        all(is.finite(weights)), all(weights > 0))
    weight <- sum(weights)
    centered <- sweep(coefficients, 1L, coefficients[, 1L], `-`)
    shift <- as.numeric(centered %*% (weights/weight))
    deviations <- sweep(centered, 1L, shift, `-`)
    list(weight = weight, mean = coefficients[, 1L] + shift, scatter = tcrossprod(sweep(deviations, 2L, sqrt(weights),
        `*`)))
}

kappa0_reference_interval_error <- function(u, moments, projection) {
    delta <- as.numeric(u - projection$projection %*% moments$mean)
    metric_product <- as.numeric(projection$metric %*% delta)
    residual_product <- as.numeric(projection$residual_gram %*% moments$mean)
    variance_terms <- projection$exact_gram * moments$scatter
    value <- moments$weight * (sum(delta * metric_product) + sum(moments$mean * residual_product)) + sum(variance_terms)
    scale <- moments$weight * (sum(abs(delta * metric_product)) + sum(abs(moments$mean * residual_product))) +
        sum(abs(variance_terms))
    if (!is.finite(value) || value < -128 * .Machine$double.eps * scale)
        stop("Invalid reference-grid squared error.")
    max(0, value)
}

# R reference retained for numerical regression checks.

kappa0_average_sine_forcing <- function(time_seq, A = 1, omega = pi) {
    dt <- diff(time_seq)
    stopifnot(length(time_seq) >= 2L, all(is.finite(time_seq)), all(dt > 0))
    midpoint <- head(time_seq, -1) + dt/2
    z <- omega * dt/2
    sinc_z <- rep(1, length(z))
    nonzero <- z != 0
    sinc_z[nonzero] <- sin(z[nonzero])/z[nonzero]
    averages <- A * sin(omega * midpoint) * sinc_z
    c(0, averages)
}

kappa0_decayed_sine_convolution <- function(t, rate, A = 1, omega = pi) {
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(t)), all(t >= 0), length(rate) == 1L, is.finite(rate), rate >= 0, is.finite(A), is.finite(omega))
    z <- (rate + (0+1i) * omega) * t
    small <- Mod(z) < 0.5
    answer <- numeric(length(t))
    if (any(small)) {
        zz <- z[small]
        term <- rep(1 + (0+0i), length(zz))
        series <- rep(0 + (0+0i), length(zz))
        for (k in 1:24) {
            term <- term * zz/(k + 1)
            series <- series + term
        }
        answer[small] <- A * exp(-rate * t[small]) * t[small] * Im(series)
    }
    if (any(!small)) {
        tt <- t[!small]
        answer[!small] <- A * Im((exp((0+1i) * omega * tt) - exp(-rate * tt))/(rate + (0+1i) * omega))
    }
    answer
}

kappa0_compile_sampled_solver <- function(cache_dir=tempdir()) {
    target <- environment(kappa0_compile_sampled_solver)
    if (!exists("kappa0_sampled_evolve_cpp", envir=target, inherits=FALSE))
        Rcpp::sourceCpp(code=r"----(
// [[Rcpp::depends(RcppEigen)]]
// [[Rcpp::plugins(cpp11)]]
#include <RcppEigen.h>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
using Eigen::VectorXd;
using Eigen::MatrixXd;
using Eigen::SparseMatrix;
typedef Eigen::SimplicialLLT<SparseMatrix<double> > SmoothFactor;

// Backward Euler/BRASIL updates and the same centered sampled-error identity
// as the R reference implementation. Every solver step is advanced.
// [[Rcpp::export]]
Rcpp::List kappa0_sampled_evolve_cpp(
    const Eigen::MappedSparseMatrix<double>& C_in,
    Rcpp::List matrices, VectorXd residues, double remainder,
    VectorXd initial, VectorXd load, VectorXd forcing,
    MatrixXd projection,
    const Eigen::MappedSparseMatrix<double>& metric_in,
    MatrixXd residual_gram, MatrixXd exact_gram, MatrixXd coefficients,
    Rcpp::IntegerVector target_steps, VectorXd weights,
    double tau, int n_steps, double forcing_mean, bool split_mean,
    double exact_mass_initial, double exact_mass_rate) {
    Eigen::setNbThreads(1);
    SparseMatrix<double> C=C_in, metric=metric_in;
    const int n=C.rows(), modes=projection.cols();
    const int samples=target_steps.size(), m=residues.size();
    if (n_steps<1 || !std::isfinite(tau) || tau<=0 || samples<1 ||
        C.cols()!=n || matrices.size()!=m || initial.size()!=n || load.size()!=n ||
        forcing.size()!=n_steps+1 || projection.rows()!=n || modes<1 ||
        coefficients.rows()!=modes || coefficients.cols()!=samples ||
        weights.size()!=samples || metric.rows()!=n || metric.cols()!=n ||
        residual_gram.rows()!=modes || residual_gram.cols()!=modes ||
        exact_gram.rows()!=modes || exact_gram.cols()!=modes)
        Rcpp::stop("Invalid smooth-reference dimensions or time grid.");
    SmoothFactor mass_factor;
    if (remainder!=0) {
        mass_factor.compute(C);
        if (mass_factor.info()!=Eigen::Success)
            Rcpp::stop("Mass factorization failed.");
    }
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<SmoothFactor> > factors;
    for (int i=0;i<m;++i) {
        SparseMatrix<double> A=Rcpp::as<SparseMatrix<double> >(matrices[i]);
        if (A.rows()!=n || A.cols()!=n)
            Rcpp::stop("Invalid shifted matrix dimensions.");
        factors.emplace_back(new SmoothFactor());
        factors.back()->compute(A);
        if (factors.back()->info()!=Eigen::Success)
            Rcpp::stop("Shifted factorization failed.");
    }
    VectorXd u=initial, rhs(n), next(n), delta(n), metric_product(n);
    VectorXd c_one=C*VectorXd::Ones(n);
    const double volume=c_one.sum();
    double expected_mass=c_one.dot(initial), max_mass_error=0;
    const bool exact_mass_checked=std::isfinite(exact_mass_initial) && std::isfinite(exact_mass_rate);
    double max_exact_mass_error=exact_mass_checked ? std::abs(expected_mass-exact_mass_initial) : NA_REAL;
    VectorXd anchor(modes), shift(modes), mean(modes), centered(modes);
    VectorXd deviation(modes), residual_product(modes);
    MatrixXd scatter(modes,modes);
    int step=0, first=0;
    double total=0, compensation=0;
    while (first<samples) {
        Rcpp::checkUserInterrupt();
        const int goal=target_steps[first];
        if (goal<1 || goal<step || goal>n_steps)
            Rcpp::stop("Invalid reference time-to-step mapping.");
        while (step<goal) {
            if ((step & 4095)==0) Rcpp::checkUserInterrupt();
            ++step;
            rhs.noalias()=C*u;
            rhs.noalias()+=tau*load*forcing[step];
            rhs.noalias()+=tau*forcing_mean*c_one;
            expected_mass+=tau*(load.sum()*forcing[step]+forcing_mean*volume);
            double next_mean=0;
            if (split_mean) {
                next_mean=rhs.sum()/volume;
                rhs.noalias()-=next_mean*c_one;
            }
            if (remainder!=0) next=remainder*mass_factor.solve(rhs);
            else next.setZero();
            for (int i=0;i<m;++i)
                next.noalias()+=residues[i]*factors[i]->solve(rhs);
            if (split_mean) {
                const double residual_mean=c_one.dot(next)/volume;
                next.array()+=next_mean-residual_mean;
            }
            u.swap(next);
            if (split_mean)
                max_mass_error=std::max(max_mass_error,std::abs(c_one.dot(u)-expected_mass));
            if (exact_mass_checked) {
                // Direct analytic law at t_k, not an accumulated recurrence.
                const double exact_mass=exact_mass_initial+exact_mass_rate*(step*tau);
                max_exact_mass_error=std::max(max_exact_mass_error,std::abs(c_one.dot(u)-exact_mass));
            }
        }
        int last=first+1;
        while (last<samples && target_steps[last]==goal) ++last;
        long double weight_sum=0;
        for (int q=first;q<last;++q) {
            if (!std::isfinite(weights[q]) || weights[q]<=0)
                Rcpp::stop("Reference weights must be positive and finite.");
            weight_sum+=weights[q];
        }
        const double weight=static_cast<double>(weight_sum);
        anchor=coefficients.col(first);
        shift.setZero();
        for (int q=first;q<last;++q) {
            if ((q & 4095)==0) Rcpp::checkUserInterrupt();
            centered=coefficients.col(q)-anchor;
            shift.noalias()+=(weights[q]/weight)*centered;
        }
        mean=anchor+shift;
        scatter.setZero();
        for (int q=first;q<last;++q) {
            centered=coefficients.col(q)-anchor;
            deviation=std::sqrt(weights[q])*(centered-shift);
            scatter.noalias()+=deviation*deviation.transpose();
        }
        delta.noalias()=u-projection*mean;
        metric_product.noalias()=metric*delta;
        residual_product.noalias()=residual_gram*mean;
        const double variance=exact_gram.cwiseProduct(scatter).sum();
        double value=weight*(delta.dot(metric_product)+mean.dot(residual_product))+variance;
        const double scale=weight*(delta.cwiseProduct(metric_product).cwiseAbs().sum()+
            mean.cwiseProduct(residual_product).cwiseAbs().sum())+
            exact_gram.cwiseProduct(scatter).cwiseAbs().sum();
        if (!std::isfinite(value) || value < -128*std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon()*scale)
            Rcpp::stop("Invalid reference-grid squared error.");
        value=std::max(0.0,value);
        const double adjusted=value-compensation;
        const double updated=total+adjusted;
        compensation=(updated-total)-adjusted;
        total=updated;
        first=last;
    }
    if (step!=n_steps) Rcpp::stop("Reference grid did not reach the final solver step.");
    return Rcpp::List::create(Rcpp::Named("error")=std::sqrt(total),
        Rcpp::Named("final_state")=u, Rcpp::Named("solver_steps")=step,
        Rcpp::Named("max_mass_error")=max_mass_error,
        Rcpp::Named("max_exact_mass_error")=max_exact_mass_error,
        Rcpp::Named("exact_mass_checked")=exact_mass_checked,
        Rcpp::Named("final_mass")=c_one.dot(u),
        Rcpp::Named("mass_checked")=split_mean);
}
)----", env=target, cacheDir=cache_dir, showOutput=FALSE, verbose=FALSE)
    invisible(TRUE)
}
```

### Smooth data, interpolation, and exact coefficient evolution

Mode numbering follows `initial_modes_tadpole.R`: mode 1 is the normalized
constant, each frequency `k*pi/2` contributes `phi`, and positive even
frequencies also contribute `psi`. Thus modes 5 and 7 are `phi_3` and
`psi_4`. Element sine/cosine-hat integrals are evaluated analytically with
small-argument series. Each nonconstant load is centered to its analytically
known zero integral at roundoff. The added constant load is `mean*C*one`.
For the mean-zero experiment the reference has exactly 17 active
columns. Only an explicitly requested nonzero-mean test appends the
function one with coefficient `initial_mean + forcing_mean*t`.

```{r kappa0-experiment-data-functions}
kappa0_mode_table <- function(max_mode = 21L) {
    table <- data.frame(k = 0L, kind = "constant")
    for (k in seq_len(max_mode)) {
        table <- rbind(table, data.frame(k = k, kind = "phi"))
        if (k %% 2L == 0L) table <- rbind(table, data.frame(k = k, kind = "psi"))
    }
    table[seq_len(max_mode), ]
}

kappa0_mesh_locations <- function(mesh) {
    # Same order as the standalone tadpole assembler: endpoints, stem, loop.
    counts <- lengths(mesh$paths)-1L
    rbind(c(1,0), c(2,0),
          if (counts[1L]>1L) cbind(1, seq_len(counts[1L]-1L)/counts[1L]) else NULL,
          if (counts[2L]>1L) cbind(2, seq_len(counts[2L]-1L)/counts[2L]) else NULL)
}

kappa0_fem_basis <- function(mesh, locations) {
    edge <- as.integer(locations[,1L])
    counts <- lengths(mesh$paths)-1L
    position <- locations[,2L]*counts[edge]
    cell <- pmin(floor(position), counts[edge]-1L)
    fraction <- position-cell
    left <- right <- integer(nrow(locations))
    for (e in 1:2) {
        ids <- which(edge==e)
        left[ids] <- mesh$paths[[e]][cell[ids]+1L]
        right[ids] <- mesh$paths[[e]][cell[ids]+2L]
    }
    Matrix::drop0(Matrix::sparseMatrix(i=rep(seq_len(nrow(locations)),2L),
        j=c(left,right), x=c(1-fraction,fraction), dims=c(nrow(locations),nrow(mesh$C))))
}

kappa0_mode_trig <- function(mode, edge) {
    k <- mode$k
    A <- B <- 0
    if (k==0L) A <- 1/sqrt(3)
    else if (mode$kind=="psi") A <- (if (edge==1L) (-1)^(k/2) else 1)/sqrt(3/2)
    else {
        normalization <- if (k%%2L==1L) sqrt(3) else 1
        if (edge==1L) A <- -2*sinpi(k/2)/normalization else B <- 1/normalization
    }
    c(A=A, B=B)
}

kappa0_mode_basis <- function(locations, modes) {
    table <- kappa0_mode_table(max(modes))
    vapply(modes, function(j) {
        out <- numeric(nrow(locations))
        for (edge in 1:2) {
            ids <- which(locations[,1L]==edge)
            x <- locations[ids,2L]*c(1,2)[edge]
            ab <- kappa0_mode_trig(table[j,],edge)
            out[ids] <- ab[1L]*cos(table$k[j]*pi*x/2) + ab[2L]*sin(table$k[j]*pi*x/2)
        }
        out
    }, numeric(nrow(locations)))
}

kappa0_trig_hat_pair <- function(a,b,w,A,B) {
    h <- b-a
    z <- w*h/2
    theta <- w*(a+b)/2
    S <- Q <- numeric(length(z))
    small <- abs(z)<0.001
    S[small] <- 1-z[small]^2/6+z[small]^4/120-z[small]^6/5040
    Q[small] <- z[small]/3-z[small]^3/30+z[small]^5/840-z[small]^7/45360
    S[!small] <- sin(z[!small])/z[!small]
    Q[!small] <- (sin(z[!small])-z[!small]*cos(z[!small]))/z[!small]^2
    v <- A*cos(theta)+B*sin(theta)
    q <- A*sin(theta)-B*cos(theta)
    cbind(h/2*(S*v+Q*q), h/2*(S*v-Q*q))
}

kappa0_mode_load <- function(mesh, j) {
    mode <- kappa0_mode_table(j)[j,]
    elements <- mesh$elements
    pair <- matrix(0,nrow(elements),2L)
    for (edge in 1:2) {
        ids <- which(elements$edge==edge)
        ab <- kappa0_mode_trig(mode,edge)
        pair[ids,] <- kappa0_trig_hat_pair(elements$a[ids],elements$b[ids],
                                         mode$k*pi/2,ab[1L],ab[2L])
    }
    summed <- rowsum(c(pair[,1L],pair[,2L]), c(elements$left,elements$right), reorder=FALSE)
    load <- numeric(nrow(mesh$C))
    load[as.integer(rownames(summed))] <- summed[,1L]
    if (mode$k>0) {
        c_one <- as.numeric(mesh$C %*% rep(1,nrow(mesh$C)))
        load <- load-sum(load)/sum(c_one)*c_one
    }
    load
}

kappa0_smooth_data <- function(h, initial_modes=c(5L,6L,8:21), initial_amplitude=10,
                               forcing_amplitude=10, initial_mean=0, forcing_mean=0) {
    stopifnot(length(initial_modes)>=1L, !anyDuplicated(initial_modes),
              all(initial_modes>=2L), all(initial_modes==as.integer(initial_modes)),
              !(7L %in% initial_modes), all(is.finite(c(initial_amplitude,forcing_amplitude,
                                                       initial_mean,forcing_mean))))
    mesh <- kappa0_tadpole_mesh(h)
    C <- mesh$C
    c_one <- as.numeric(C %*% rep(1,nrow(C)))
    loads <- vapply(initial_modes,function(j) kappa0_mode_load(mesh,j),numeric(nrow(C)))
    b0 <- initial_mean*c_one+initial_amplitude/sqrt(length(initial_modes))*rowSums(loads)
    initial <- as.numeric(Matrix::solve(C,b0))
    list(mesh=mesh, C=C, G=mesh$G, initial=initial,
         spatial_load=forcing_amplitude*kappa0_mode_load(mesh,7L),
         initial_modes=initial_modes, initial_amplitude=initial_amplitude,
         forcing_amplitude=forcing_amplitude, initial_mean=initial_mean, forcing_mean=forcing_mean)
}

kappa0_smooth_reference <- function(reference_mesh, data, alpha, diffusion, A=1, omega=pi) {
    modes <- sort(unique(c(data$initial_modes,7L)))
    E <- kappa0_mode_basis(kappa0_mesh_locations(reference_mesh),modes)
    table <- kappa0_mode_table(max(modes))
    rates <- diffusion*(table$k[modes]*pi/2)^alpha
    initial <- ifelse(modes %in% data$initial_modes,
                       data$initial_amplitude/sqrt(length(data$initial_modes)),0)
    forcing <- ifelse(modes==7L,data$forcing_amplitude,0)
    include_mean <- data$initial_mean!=0 || data$forcing_mean!=0
    coefficients <- function(t) {
        out <- vapply(seq_along(rates),function(j)
            initial[j]*exp(-rates[j]*t) + forcing[j]*
                kappa0_decayed_sine_convolution(t,rates[j],A,omega),numeric(length(t)))
        out <- matrix(out,nrow=length(t),ncol=length(rates))
        out <- t(out)
        if(include_mean) rbind(out,data$initial_mean+data$forcing_mean*t) else out
    }
    list(basis=if(include_mean) cbind(E,1) else E, coefficients=coefficients, rates=rates)
}

kappa0_sampled_error <- function(op, grid, initial, load, forcing, reference_grid,
                                 coefficients, projection, forcing_mean=0,
                                 split_mean=TRUE, engine=c("cpp","R"),
                                 exact_mass_initial=NA_real_, exact_mass_rate=NA_real_) {
    engine <- match.arg(engine)
    stopifnot(length(initial)==nrow(op$C), length(load)==length(initial),
              length(forcing)==length(grid$times),
              isTRUE(all.equal(grid$time_step,op$time_step)),
              reference_grid$times[1L]==grid$times[1L],
              tail(reference_grid$times,1L)==tail(grid$times,1L))
    times <- reference_grid$times[-1L]
    weights <- diff(reference_grid$times)
    coef <- as.matrix(coefficients(times))
    targets <- as.integer(findInterval(times,grid$times,left.open=TRUE))
    stopifnot(ncol(coef)==length(times), all(is.finite(coef)),
              all(targets>=1L), all(targets<=grid$N))
    if (engine=="R") {
        u <- initial
        total <- compensation <- 0
        step <- 0L
        one <- rep(1,length(u)); c_one <- as.numeric(op$C %*% one)
        expected <- sum(c_one*u); mass_error <- 0
        exact_checked <- is.finite(exact_mass_initial) && is.finite(exact_mass_rate)
        exact_error <- if(exact_checked) abs(expected-exact_mass_initial) else NA_real_
        runs <- rle(targets); first <- 1L
        for (run in seq_along(runs$values)) {
            while (step<runs$values[run]) {
                step <- step+1L
                F <- load*forcing[step+1L]+forcing_mean*c_one
                rhs <- as.numeric(op$C %*% u)+grid$time_step*F
                u <- if (split_mean) my.solver.kappa0(op,rhs) else kappa0_restricted_solve(op,rhs)
                expected <- expected+grid$time_step*sum(F)
                if (split_mean) mass_error <- max(mass_error,abs(sum(c_one*u)-expected))
                if (exact_checked) exact_error <- max(exact_error,
                    abs(sum(c_one*u)-(exact_mass_initial+exact_mass_rate*grid$times[step+1L])))
            }
            last <- first+runs$lengths[run]-1L
            columns <- seq.int(first,last)
            moments <- kappa0_reference_coefficient_moments(coef[,columns,drop=FALSE],weights[columns])
            value <- kappa0_reference_interval_error(u,moments,projection)
            adjusted <- value-compensation; updated <- total+adjusted
            compensation <- (updated-total)-adjusted; total <- updated
            first <- last+1L
        }
        return(list(error=sqrt(total),final_state=u,solver_steps=step,
                    max_mass_error=mass_error,max_exact_mass_error=exact_error,
                    exact_mass_checked=exact_checked,final_mass=sum(c_one*u),mass_checked=split_mean))
    }
    kappa0_compile_sampled_solver()
    matrices <- if(op$beta==1) list(op$LHS) else op$partial_fraction_terms
    residues <- if(op$beta==1) 1 else op$residues
    remainder <- if(op$beta==1) 0 else op$remainder
    general <- function(x) methods::as(methods::as(x,"generalMatrix"),"CsparseMatrix")
    kappa0_sampled_evolve_cpp(general(op$C),lapply(matrices,general),residues,remainder,
        as.numeric(initial),as.numeric(load),as.numeric(forcing),projection$projection,
        general(projection$metric),projection$residual_gram,projection$exact_gram,coef,
        targets,weights,grid$time_step,grid$N,forcing_mean,split_mean,
        exact_mass_initial,exact_mass_rate)
}
```

### Rough forcing, restricted operator, and common experiment runners

The rough load keeps exactly the modes `j < J` on a dyadic solver mesh;
all higher modes of the infinite forcing have zero sine-hat load. The
finite reference uses a fixed cutoff `K >= max(J)` on every solver mesh
and a spatial grid `reference_J >= K+2`. The cutoff bound is checked
against every squared measured error, not just its largest value.

```{r kappa0-experiment-runners}
kappa0_rough_mesh <- function(J) {
    stopifnot(J>=3L, J<=20L, J==as.integer(J))
    h <- 2^-J; n <- 2^(J-1L)-1L
    C <- Matrix::bandSparse(n,k=c(-1L,0L,1L),diagonals=list(
        rep(2*h/3,n-1L),rep(8*h/3,n),rep(2*h/3,n-1L)))
    G <- Matrix::bandSparse(n,k=c(-1L,0L,1L),diagonals=list(
        rep(-4/h,n-1L),rep(8/h,n),rep(-4/h,n-1L)))
    j <- seq_len(J-1L); x <- seq_len(n)*h; theta <- pi*2^j*h
    B <- outer(x,2^j,function(x,k) sinpi(x*k))*
         rep(4*h*(sin(theta/2)/(theta/2))^2,each=n)
    list(J=J,h=h,C=C,G=G,x=x,load=as.numeric(B %*% (1/j)))
}

kappa0_rough_reference <- function(J,cutoff) {
    stopifnot(cutoff>=1L,cutoff==as.integer(cutoff),J>=cutoff+2L,J<=22L)
    h <- 2^-J; n <- 2^(J-1L)-1L
    if (8*n*cutoff/1024^2>1024) stop("Rough reference basis exceeds 1 GiB guard.")
    C <- Matrix::bandSparse(n,k=c(-1L,0L,1L),diagonals=list(
        rep(2*h/3,n-1L),rep(8*h/3,n),rep(2*h/3,n-1L)))
    x <- seq_len(n)*h
    list(J=J,cutoff=cutoff,C=C,x=x,
         basis=outer(x,2^seq_len(cutoff),function(x,k) sinpi(x*k)))
}

kappa0_rough_basis <- function(J,x) {
    pos <- x*2^J; left <- as.integer(floor(pos)); f <- pos-left
    n <- 2^(J-1L)-1L; rows <- seq_along(x)
    kl <- left>=1L & left<=n; kr <- left+1L>=1L & left+1L<=n
    Matrix::drop0(Matrix::sparseMatrix(i=c(rows[kl],rows[kr]),
        j=c(left[kl],left[kr]+1L),x=c(1-f[kl],f[kr]),dims=c(length(x),n)))
}

kappa0_rough_operator <- function(mesh,beta,m,time_step,diffusion=1,gamma_star=1/3) {
    stopifnot(beta>0,beta<=1,kappa0_positive_scalar(gamma_star),
              kappa0_positive_scalar(time_step),kappa0_positive_scalar(diffusion))
    factorize <- function(A) Matrix::Cholesky(Matrix::forceSymmetric(A),LDL=FALSE)
    op <- list(C=mesh$C,G=mesh$G,beta=beta,time_step=time_step,diffusion=diffusion,
               scale.factor=gamma_star,m=m,mass_factor=factorize(mesh$C))
    if (beta==1) {
        op$LHS <- mesh$C+time_step*diffusion*mesh$G
        op$factorization <- factorize(op$LHS)
    } else {
        op$coefficients <- kappa0_brasil_coefficients(m,beta)
        transfer <- kappa0_brasil_partial_fractions(op$coefficients,time_step,diffusion*gamma_star^beta)
        op$poles <- transfer$p; op$residues <- transfer$r; op$remainder <- transfer$k
        op$partial_fraction_terms <- lapply(op$poles,function(p) mesh$G/gamma_star-p*mesh$C)
        op$factorizations <- lapply(op$partial_fraction_terms,factorize)
    }
    op
}

kappa0_restricted_solve <- function(op,b) {
    if (op$beta==1) return(as.numeric(Matrix::solve(op$factorization,b,system="A")))
    u <- op$remainder*as.numeric(Matrix::solve(op$mass_factor,b,system="A"))
    for (i in seq_along(op$residues)) u <- u+op$residues[i]*
        as.numeric(Matrix::solve(op$factorizations[[i]],b,system="A"))
    u
}

kappa0_map_cases <- function(cases,FUN,workers=1L) {
    safe <- function(i) tryCatch(FUN(i),error=function(e) list(failed=conditionMessage(e)))
    values <- if(workers>1L && .Platform$OS.type=="unix")
        parallel::mclapply(cases,safe,mc.cores=min(workers,length(cases)),mc.preschedule=FALSE)
        else lapply(cases,safe)
    failed <- vapply(values,function(x) !is.list(x) || !is.null(x$failed),logical(1))
    if(any(failed)) stop("Experiment failed: ",paste(vapply(values[failed],function(x)
        if(is.list(x)) x$failed else as.character(x),character(1)),collapse="; "))
    values
}

kappa0_run_smooth_study <- function(cfg) {
    stopifnot(cfg$study %in% c("h","tau"),cfg$kappa==0,cfg$gamma_star>0)
    kappa0_compile_sampled_solver()
    ref_mesh <- kappa0_tadpole_mesh(cfg$reference_h)
    ref_grid <- kappa0_time_grid(cfg$T_final,cfg$reference_tau)
    axis <- if(cfg$study=="h") cfg$h else cfg$tau
    rows <- vector("list",length(axis))
    for(i in seq_along(axis)) {
        data <- kappa0_smooth_data(if(cfg$study=="h") axis[i] else cfg$h,
            cfg$initial_modes,cfg$initial_amplitude,cfg$forcing_amplitude,
            cfg$initial_mean,cfg$forcing_mean)
        grid <- kappa0_time_grid(cfg$T_final,if(cfg$study=="tau") axis[i] else cfg$tau)
        forcing <- kappa0_average_sine_forcing(grid$times,cfg$A,cfg$omega)
        ref <- kappa0_smooth_reference(ref_mesh,data,cfg$alpha[1],cfg$diffusion,cfg$A,cfg$omega)
        Psi <- kappa0_fem_basis(data$mesh,kappa0_mesh_locations(ref_mesh))
        projection <- kappa0_prepare_reference_error(Psi,ref_mesh$C,ref$basis)
        values <- kappa0_map_cases(seq_along(cfg$alpha),function(j) {
            alpha <- cfg$alpha[j]
            ref <- kappa0_smooth_reference(ref_mesh,data,
                       alpha,cfg$diffusion,cfg$A,cfg$omega)
            op <- my.fractional.operators.kappa0(data$G,alpha/2,data$C,
                      cfg$gamma_star,cfg$m,grid$time_step,cfg$diffusion)
            value <- kappa0_sampled_error(op,grid,data$initial,data$spatial_load,forcing,
                       ref_grid,ref$coefficients,projection,forcing_mean=cfg$forcing_mean,
                       exact_mass_initial=3*cfg$initial_mean,exact_mass_rate=3*cfg$forcing_mean)
            data.frame(alpha=alpha,axis=if(cfg$study=="h") data$mesh$h else grid$time_step,
                error=value$error,max_mass_error=value$max_mass_error,
                max_exact_mass_error=value$max_exact_mass_error,
                steps=grid$N,unknowns=nrow(data$C))
        },cfg$workers)
        rows[[i]] <- do.call(rbind,values)
    }
    results <- do.call(rbind,rows)
    rates <- do.call(rbind,lapply(cfg$alpha,function(a) {
        d <- results[results$alpha==a,]
        data.frame(alpha=a,reference=if(cfg$study=="h") 2 else 1,
                   observed=unname(coef(lm(log(error)~log(axis),data=d))[2L]))
    }))
    if(any(results$max_mass_error>1e-8)) stop("Smooth-study mass balance check failed.")
    list(results=results,rates=rates)
}

kappa0_run_rough_study <- function(cfg) {
    stopifnot(cfg$kappa==0,cfg$cutoff>=max(cfg$J))
    kappa0_compile_sampled_solver()
    reference <- kappa0_rough_reference(cfg$reference_J,cfg$cutoff)
    ref_grid <- kappa0_time_grid(cfg$T_final,cfg$reference_tau)
    grid <- kappa0_time_grid(cfg$T_final,cfg$tau)
    meshes <- lapply(cfg$J,kappa0_rough_mesh)
    projections <- lapply(meshes,function(mesh) kappa0_prepare_reference_error(
        kappa0_rough_basis(mesh$J,reference$x),reference$C,reference$basis))
    cases <- expand.grid(mesh=seq_along(cfg$J),alpha=seq_along(cfg$alpha))
    values <- kappa0_map_cases(seq_len(nrow(cases)),function(i) {
        mesh <- meshes[[cases$mesh[i]]]; alpha <- cfg$alpha[cases$alpha[i]]
        j <- seq_len(cfg$cutoff); rates <- cfg$diffusion*(pi*2^j)^alpha
        coefficients <- function(t) -expm1(-outer(rates,t))/(j*rates)
        op <- kappa0_rough_operator(mesh,alpha/2,cfg$m,grid$time_step,cfg$diffusion,cfg$gamma_star)
        value <- kappa0_sampled_error(op,grid,rep(0,nrow(mesh$C)),mesh$load,
            rep(1,length(grid$times)),ref_grid,coefficients,projections[[cases$mesh[i]]],split_mean=FALSE)
        bound <- cfg$T_final/(cfg$diffusion^2*pi^(2*alpha)) *
                 2^(-2*alpha*(cfg$cutoff+1))/((cfg$cutoff+1)^2*(1-2^(-2*alpha)))
        data.frame(alpha=alpha,axis=mesh$h,J=mesh$J,error=value$error,
            corrected_error=mesh$J*value$error,cutoff_squared_bound=bound,
            tail_squared_fraction=bound/value$error^2,steps=grid$N,
            unknowns=nrow(mesh$C),mass_by_antisymmetry=0)
    },cfg$workers)
    results <- do.call(rbind,values)
    if(any(results$tail_squared_fraction>cfg$max_tail_squared_fraction))
        stop("Reference cutoff budget failed; increase cutoff and reference_J together.")
    rates <- do.call(rbind,lapply(cfg$alpha,function(a) {
        d <- results[results$alpha==a,]
        data.frame(alpha=a,reference=a,
            raw=unname(coef(lm(log(error)~log(axis),data=d))[2L]),
            observed=unname(coef(lm(log(corrected_error)~log(axis),data=d))[2L]))
    }))
    list(results=results,rates=rates)
}

kappa0_discrete_be_coefficients <- function(data,spectrum,grid,alpha,diffusion,A=1,omega=pi) {
    V <- spectrum$vectors
    y <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(V,data$C %*% data$initial))
    f <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(V,data$spatial_load))
    c_one <- as.numeric(data$C %*% rep(1,nrow(data$C)))
    fc <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(V,data$forcing_mean*c_one))
    rates <- diffusion*spectrum$values^(alpha/2)
    H <- 1/(1+grid$time_step*rates)
    forcing <- kappa0_average_sine_forcing(grid$times,A,omega)
    coefficients <- matrix(0,length(y),grid$N+1L); coefficients[,1L] <- y
    for(k in seq_len(grid$N)) {
        y <- H*(y+grid$time_step*(f*forcing[k+1L]+fc))
        coefficients[,k+1L] <- y
    }
    list(coefficients=coefficients,forcing=forcing,modal_load=f,modal_constant_load=fc,rates=rates)
}

kappa0_isolated_m_case <- function(data,spectrum,grid,reference,alpha,m,diffusion,gamma_star) {
    op <- my.fractional.operators.kappa0(data$G,alpha/2,data$C,gamma_star,m,grid$time_step,diffusion)
    n <- nrow(data$C)
    projection <- list(projection=spectrum$vectors,metric=data$C,
                       residual_gram=matrix(0,n,n),exact_gram=diag(n))
    # The reference samples are the BE vectors at these very same time nodes.
    lookup <- function(t) reference$coefficients[,pmin(grid$N,as.integer(round(t/grid$time_step)))+1L,drop=FALSE]
    value <- kappa0_sampled_error(op,grid,data$initial,data$spatial_load,reference$forcing,
               grid,lookup,projection,forcing_mean=data$forcing_mean,
               exact_mass_initial=3*data$initial_mean,exact_mass_rate=3*data$forcing_mean)
    H <- rep(1,n)
    if(alpha==2) H <- 1/(1+grid$time_step*diffusion*spectrum$values)
    else {
        S <- kappa0_brasil_inverse(spectrum$values[-1L]/gamma_star,op$coefficients)
        H[-1L] <- S/(S+grid$time_step*diffusion*gamma_star^(alpha/2))
    }
    y <- reference$coefficients[,1L]; total <- 0
    for(k in seq_len(grid$N)) {
        y <- H*(y+grid$time_step*(reference$modal_load*reference$forcing[k+1L]+reference$modal_constant_load))
        dy <- y-reference$coefficients[,k+1L]
        total <- total+grid$time_step*sum(dy^2)
    }
    modal_error <- sqrt(total)
    gap <- kappa0_l2_norm(data$C,value$final_state-as.numeric(spectrum$vectors %*% y))
    data.frame(alpha=alpha,m=m,axis=m,error=value$error,product_error=modal_error,
        absolute_error_disagreement=abs(value$error-modal_error),final_state_gap_C=gap,
        max_mass_error=value$max_mass_error,max_exact_mass_error=value$max_exact_mass_error)
}

kappa0_run_m_study <- function(cfg) {
    kappa0_compile_sampled_solver()
    data <- kappa0_smooth_data(cfg$h,cfg$initial_modes,cfg$initial_amplitude,
                cfg$forcing_amplitude,cfg$initial_mean,cfg$forcing_mean)
    grid <- kappa0_time_grid(cfg$T_final,cfg$tau)
    spectrum <- kappa0_discrete_spectrum(data$C,data$G)
    stopifnot(cfg$gamma_star<=spectrum$values[2L])
    values <- kappa0_map_cases(seq_along(cfg$alpha),function(i) {
        alpha <- cfg$alpha[i]
        reference <- kappa0_discrete_be_coefficients(data,spectrum,grid,alpha,cfg$diffusion,cfg$A,cfg$omega)
        rows <- lapply(cfg$m,function(m) kappa0_isolated_m_case(data,spectrum,grid,reference,
                  alpha,m,cfg$diffusion,cfg$gamma_star))
        list(rows=do.call(rbind,rows))
    },cfg$workers)
    results <- do.call(rbind,lapply(values,`[[`,"rows"))
    reference <- kappa0_discrete_be_coefficients(data,spectrum,grid,2,cfg$diffusion,cfg$A,cfg$omega)
    control <- kappa0_isolated_m_case(data,spectrum,grid,reference,2,min(cfg$m),cfg$diffusion,cfg$gamma_star)
    results$noise_indicator <- pmax(results$absolute_error_disagreement,control$error,.Machine$double.xmin)
    results$resolved <- results$product_error>100*results$noise_indicator
    slopes <- function(d) if(nrow(d)<2L) NA_real_ else unname(coef(lm(log(error)~sqrt(m),data=d))[2L])
    rates <- do.call(rbind,lapply(cfg$alpha,function(a) {
        d <- results[results$alpha==a,]
        data.frame(alpha=a,reference=-2*pi*sqrt(a/2),observed=slopes(d),
                   resolved_only=slopes(d[d$resolved,]),resolved_orders=sum(d$resolved))
    }))
    unit <- do.call(rbind,lapply(cfg$alpha,function(a) do.call(rbind,lapply(cfg$m,function(m) {
        x <- c(0,sort(exp(seq(log(0.001),0,length.out=10001L))))
        c <- kappa0_brasil_coefficients(m,a/2)
        data.frame(alpha=a,m=m,error=max(abs(kappa0_brasil_power(x,c)-x^(a/2))))
    }))))
    if(any(results$max_mass_error>1e-8)) stop("Isolated-m mass balance check failed.")
    list(results=results,rates=rates,control=control,spectrum=spectrum$diagnostics,unit_errors=unit)
}
```

### Manual computation and saved-result provenance

The convergence notebooks declare all experiment parameters explicitly.
Their computation chunks have `eval=FALSE`; only running those chunks
manually invokes the experiment runners. Knitting reads the named saved
result, checks its scientific settings, and redraws plots. Missing or
incompatible results produce an error and never start a simulation.
No global option can enable computation while knitting.

`kappa0_compute_study()` always performs the requested experiment when
called explicitly and writes its settings, source hashes, package versions,
and timestamp. It does not run implementation comparisons or refinement
tests. Those scripts and their outputs are kept separately in
`/home/rierasl/Desktop/DOCS/NAP/true_diff_internal`, outside the reports.
The numerical mass-balance diagnostics and isolated-m integer-power
control remain part of the scientific experiment, as in the original
notebooks.

```{r kappa0-experiment-computation-function}
kappa0_compute_study <- function(cfg,notebook_file,output_file) {
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(cfg$alpha)),all(cfg$alpha>0),all(cfg$alpha<2),
              !anyDuplicated(cfg$alpha),cfg$kappa==0,cfg$gamma_star>0)
    versions <- vapply(c("Matrix","rSPDE","Rcpp","RcppEigen"),function(p)
                       as.character(utils::packageVersion(p)),character(1))
    kappa0_compile_sampled_solver()
    started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    result <- switch(cfg$study,m=kappa0_run_m_study(cfg),h=kappa0_run_smooth_study(cfg),
                     tau=kappa0_run_smooth_study(cfg),rough_h=kappa0_run_rough_study(cfg))
    result$mass_error_definition <- list(
        max_mass_error="maximum absolute mass residual against accumulated discrete recurrence",
        max_exact_mass_error="max over every time node including t0 of abs(1^T C U_k - 3*(initial_mean+forcing_mean*t_k))")
    result$parameters <- cfg
    result$source_hashes <- tools::md5sum(c("kappa0func.Rmd",notebook_file))
    result$package_versions <- versions
    result$elapsed_seconds <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]-started
    result$generated_at <- format(Sys.time(),"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z",tz="Asia/Riyadh")
    result$error_definition <- if(cfg$study=="m") "isolated discrete BE space-time error"
        else "sampled continuum-reference space-time error, consistent reference mass"
    dir.create(dirname(output_file),recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
    saveRDS(result,output_file)
    result
}
```

## 11. Separate nonzero-mean zero-shift benchmark

`true_diff_zero_shift_benchmark.Rmd` uses the following parameterized
functions for its three experiments. They are separate from the mean-zero
convergence studies. The data are the manuscript's `u0=f=1+phi`, with
`phi=sin(2*pi*x)` on the loop and zero on the stem. For a shift kappa,
the continuum constant and phi coefficients both solve `a' + rate*a = 1`,
with initial value 1 and rates `nu*kappa^alpha` and
`nu*((2*pi)^2+kappa^2)^(alpha/2)`, respectively.

The generalized eigenvectors of `(G+kappa^2*C,C)` are those of `(G,C)`;
only their eigenvalues change, by adding `kappa^2`. Thus the small-shift
spectral comparison uses the same mass-orthonormal numerical eigenbasis,
with the constant eigenvalue set analytically before taking its power.
For autonomous forcing the closed scalar BE recurrence is exactly the
same discrete method as repeated BE steps. It avoids 500,000 dense
matrix-vector updates in the spectral benchmark. The BRASIL benchmark
instead advances every step through the cached shifted sparse solves.
No internal implementation tests are run by these functions.

```{r kappa0-benchmark-functions}
kappa0_benchmark_scalar <- function(rate,t,N=NULL) {
    if(rate==0) return(1+t)
    log_decay <- if(is.null(N)) -rate*t else -N*log1p(rate*t/N)
    exp(log_decay)-expm1(log_decay)/rate
}

kappa0_benchmark_exact <- function(edge,x,t,alpha=1.2,diffusion=1,kappa=0) {
    mean <- kappa0_benchmark_scalar(diffusion*kappa^alpha,t)
    phi <- kappa0_benchmark_scalar(diffusion*((2*pi)^2+kappa^2)^(alpha/2),t)
    mean+phi*kappa0_phi(edge,x)
}

kappa0_benchmark_spectral <- function(data,spectrum,alpha,T_final,diffusion=1,
                                      kappa=0,N=NULL) {
    stopifnot(length(kappa)==1L,is.finite(kappa),kappa>=0)
    shifted <- spectrum
    shifted$values <- spectrum$values+kappa^2
    kappa0_autonomous_reference(data$C,shifted,data$initial,data$spatial_load,
                                alpha,T_final,N=N,diffusion=diffusion)
}

kappa0_compute_benchmark <- function(cfg,notebook_file,output_file) {
    stopifnot(cfg$kappa==0,cfg$alpha>0,cfg$alpha<2,cfg$T_final>0,cfg$diffusion>0,
              cfg$gamma_star>0,all(cfg$kappa_vector>=0),
              all(cfg$temporal_N>=1L),all(cfg$temporal_N==as.integer(cfg$temporal_N)))
    started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    cache <- new.env(parent=emptyenv())
    get_data <- function(h) {
        key <- sprintf("%.16g",h)
        if(!exists(key,cache,inherits=FALSE)) {
            data <- kappa0_tadpole_data(h)
            assign(key,list(data=data,spectrum=kappa0_discrete_spectrum(data$C,data$G)),cache)
        }
        get(key,cache,inherits=FALSE)
    }
    space_grid <- kappa0_time_grid(cfg$T_final,cfg$spatial_tau)
    spatial <- do.call(rbind,lapply(cfg$spatial_h,function(h) {
        item <- get_data(h); data <- item$data
        be <- kappa0_benchmark_spectral(data,item$spectrum,cfg$alpha,cfg$T_final,
                                         cfg$diffusion,N=space_grid$N)
        exact <- function(edge,x) kappa0_benchmark_exact(edge,x,cfg$T_final,cfg$alpha,cfg$diffusion)
        data.frame(h=data$mesh$h,error=kappa0_final_error(data$mesh,be,exact),
            mass_error=abs(sum(data$C %*% be)-3*(1+cfg$T_final)),tau=space_grid$time_step)
    }))
    spatial$rate <- c(NA_real_,log(head(spatial$error,-1)/tail(spatial$error,-1))/
                                   log(head(spatial$h,-1)/tail(spatial$h,-1)))
    item <- get_data(cfg$temporal_h); data <- item$data
    semidiscrete <- kappa0_benchmark_spectral(data,item$spectrum,cfg$alpha,cfg$T_final,cfg$diffusion)
    temporal_table <- function(Ns) {
        table <- do.call(rbind,lapply(Ns,function(N) {
            be <- kappa0_benchmark_spectral(data,item$spectrum,cfg$alpha,cfg$T_final,cfg$diffusion,N=N)
            data.frame(tau=cfg$T_final/N,N=N,error=kappa0_l2_norm(data$C,be-semidiscrete),
                       mass_error=abs(sum(data$C %*% be)-3*(1+cfg$T_final)))
        }))
        table$rate <- c(NA_real_,log(head(table$error,-1)/tail(table$error,-1))/
                                         log(head(table$tau,-1)/tail(table$tau,-1)))
        table$error_per_tau <- table$error/table$tau
        table
    }
    temporal <- temporal_table(cfg$temporal_N)
    temporal_paper <- temporal_table(if(is.null(cfg$temporal_paper_N)) cfg$temporal_N else cfg$temporal_paper_N)
    temporal_fit <- data.frame(reference=1,observed=unname(coef(lm(log(error)~log(tau),data=temporal))[2L]),
                               N_min=min(temporal$N),N_max=max(temporal$N))
    positive_time <- seq.int(2L,nrow(data$C))
    time_rates <- cfg$diffusion*item$spectrum$values[positive_time]^(cfg$alpha/2)
    time_initial <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(item$spectrum$vectors,data$C %*% data$initial))[positive_time]
    time_forcing <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(item$spectrum$vectors,data$spatial_load))[positive_time]
    temporal_fit$asymptotic_error_constant <- cfg$T_final/2*sqrt(sum(
        ((time_initial-time_forcing/time_rates)*time_rates^2*exp(-time_rates*cfg$T_final))^2))
    temporal_fit$finest_error_per_tau <- tail(temporal$error_per_tau,1L)
    temporal_fit$finest_ratio_relative_gap <- abs(temporal_fit$finest_error_per_tau/
                                                temporal_fit$asymptotic_error_constant-1)
    item <- get_data(cfg$rational_h);data <- item$data;spectrum <- item$spectrum
    stopifnot(cfg$gamma_star<=spectrum$values[2L])
    grid <- kappa0_time_grid(cfg$T_final,cfg$rational_tau)
    reference <- vapply(seq_len(grid$N),function(k)
        kappa0_benchmark_spectral(data,spectrum,cfg$alpha,grid$times[k+1L],cfg$diffusion,N=k),
        numeric(nrow(data$C)))
    # Modal diagnostics use all positive FEM eigenvalues. For the given
    # aligned sine data, only one positive eigenvalue (a repeated pair) is excited.
    V <- spectrum$vectors
    positive <- seq.int(2L,nrow(data$C))
    lambda <- spectrum$values[positive]
    initial_coef <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(V,data$C %*% data$initial))[positive]
    forcing_coef <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(V,data$spatial_load))[positive]
    rates <- cfg$diffusion*lambda^(cfg$alpha/2)
    k <- seq_len(grid$N)
    log_q <- -log1p(grid$time_step*rates)
    decay <- exp(outer(log_q,k));gain <- -expm1(outer(log_q,k))/rates
    reference_modal <- decay*initial_coef+gain*forcing_coef
    reference_unit <- decay+gain
    tolerance <- 1e-9*max(1,sqrt(sum(initial_coef^2)),sqrt(sum(forcing_coef^2)))
    excited <- abs(initial_coef)>tolerance | abs(forcing_coef)>tolerance
    spectrum_diagnostics <- data.frame(mode=positive,eigenvalue=lambda,
        inverse_argument=cfg$gamma_star/lambda,initial_coefficient=initial_coef,
        forcing_coefficient=forcing_coef,excited=excited)
    projected_phi_norm <- sqrt(sum(initial_coef^2))
    mass_rows <- list()
    rational <- do.call(rbind,lapply(cfg$m_vector,function(m) {
        op <- my.fractional.operators.kappa0(data$G,cfg$alpha/2,data$C,cfg$gamma_star,
                                            m,grid$time_step,cfg$diffusion)
        evolved <- kappa0_evolution(op,data$initial,grid$N,
                       function(left,right) data$spatial_load,keep_history=TRUE)
        delta <- evolved$history[,-1L,drop=FALSE]-reference
        error <- sqrt(grid$time_step*sum(delta*as.matrix(data$C %*% delta)))
        S <- kappa0_brasil_inverse(lambda/cfg$gamma_star,op$coefficients)
        rational_rates <- cfg$diffusion*cfg$gamma_star^(cfg$alpha/2)/S
        log_H <- -log1p(grid$time_step*rational_rates)
        decay_m <- exp(outer(log_H,k));gain_m <- -expm1(outer(log_H,k))/rational_rates
        modal <- decay_m*initial_coef+gain_m*forcing_coef
        modal_error <- sqrt(grid$time_step*sum((modal-reference_modal)^2))
        # Exact induced norm for the fixed-mesh family u0=g, f(t)=g:
        # diagonalization makes its squared space-time norm a diagonal form.
        operator_error <- max(sqrt(grid$time_step*rowSums((decay_m+gain_m-reference_unit)^2)))
        source_x <- c(0,exp(seq(log(1e-14),0,length.out=20001L)))
        source_uniform <- max(abs(kappa0_brasil_power(source_x,op$coefficients)-source_x^(cfg$alpha/2)))
        point_error <- if(any(excited)) max(abs(S[excited]-(cfg$gamma_star/lambda[excited])^(cfg$alpha/2))) else 0
        expected <- 3*(1+grid$times)
        mass_rows[[length(mass_rows)+1L]] <<- data.frame(m=m,time=grid$times,
            mass=evolved$mass,expected_mass=expected,mass_difference=evolved$mass-expected)
        disagreement <- abs(error-modal_error)
        data.frame(m=m,error=error,modal_error=modal_error,
            sparse_modal_disagreement=disagreement,
            operator_error=operator_error,operator_bound_for_phi=projected_phi_norm*operator_error,
            resolvent_error=max(abs(exp(log_H)-exp(log_q))),
            source_point_error=point_error,sampled_source_uniform_error=source_uniform,
            final_error=kappa0_l2_norm(data$C,delta[,grid$N]),
            max_mass_error=max(abs(evolved$mass-expected)),
            recurrence_mass_error=evolved$max_mass_error,
            partial_fraction_error=op$reconstruction_error,
            resolved=modal_error>100*max(disagreement,.Machine$double.eps))
    }))
    item <- get_data(cfg$continuity_h);data <- item$data
    shift_grid <- kappa0_time_grid(cfg$T_final,cfg$continuity_tau)
    continuity <- do.call(rbind,lapply(cfg$kappa_vector,function(kappa) {
        be <- kappa0_benchmark_spectral(data,item$spectrum,cfg$alpha,cfg$T_final,
                                         cfg$diffusion,kappa=kappa,N=shift_grid$N)
        exact <- function(edge,x) kappa0_benchmark_exact(edge,x,cfg$T_final,
                                                        cfg$alpha,cfg$diffusion,kappa)
        mean_be <- kappa0_benchmark_scalar(cfg$diffusion*kappa^cfg$alpha,cfg$T_final,shift_grid$N)
        mean_exact <- kappa0_benchmark_scalar(cfg$diffusion*kappa^cfg$alpha,cfg$T_final)
        data.frame(kappa=kappa,error=kappa0_final_error(data$mesh,be,exact),
            discrete_mass_error=abs(sum(data$C %*% be)-3*mean_be),
            continuous_mass_difference=abs(sum(data$C %*% be)-3*mean_exact))
    }))
    result <- list(parameters=cfg,spatial=spatial,temporal=temporal,temporal_paper=temporal_paper,
        temporal_fit=temporal_fit,rational=rational,rational_spectrum=spectrum_diagnostics,
        projected_phi_norm=projected_phi_norm,
        rational_mass=do.call(rbind,mass_rows),continuity=continuity,
        source_hashes=tools::md5sum(c("kappa0func.Rmd",notebook_file)),
        package_versions=vapply(c("Matrix","rSPDE"),function(p)
            as.character(utils::packageVersion(p)),character(1)),
        elapsed_seconds=proc.time()[["elapsed"]]-started,
        generated_at=format(Sys.time(),"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z",tz="Asia/Riyadh"))
    dir.create(dirname(output_file),recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
    saveRDS(result,output_file)
    result
}
```
